news.title: Mother of 7-year-old killed in crash regrets letting her leave dance class with her father
news.summary: Ariella Nur died in a crash along Macland Road on Oct. 28. Cobb County police have since arrested her father, John Nur.

news.title: Man shot, rushed to the hospital after possible suspects drove off
news.summary: An investigation is underway after a man was shot Thursday night in southeast Atlanta.

news.title: ‘My mom deserves justice’: Daughter speaks out after Army veteran killed in Bartow County dog attack
news.summary: The daughter of a 36-year-old Army veteran who investigators say was mauled to death by dogs in Bartow County is speaking out about her mother’s horrific death.

news.title: Acworth man gets two life sentences for child sex crimes, DA says

news.title: Secret Service finds card skimmers in metro Atlanta EBT crackdown
news.summary: Secret Service agents have seized 22 credit card skimmers in a three-day operation in metro Atlanta stores, gas stations, and at ATMs, in an effort to combat EBT fraud.

news.title: Driver dies day after crash in Powder Springs, police say
news.summary: A driver involved in a crash at a Powder Springs intersection earlier this week has died, according to the Cobb County Police Department.

news.title: Police tie suspect in gas station clerk killing to second scene
news.summary: The man charged with shooting and killing a southwest Atlanta gas station clerk last week was also connected to a second scene about a mile away around the same time, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Cobb County police mourn death of 19-year veteran officer
news.summary: The Cobb County Police Department is mourning the death of Officer Jared Israel, a 19-year veteran of the force who died Tuesday.

news.title: Prominent Atlanta attorney who repped Young Thug set to defend Kroy Biermann Jr. in sexual assault case
news.summary: Biermann Jr. faces multiple charges, including aggravated sexual battery and aggravated sodomy.

news.title: Woman found dead behind vacant Bartow home died in dog attack, GBI says
news.summary: A 36-year-old woman found dead behind an abandoned home in Bartow County earlier this week was killed in a dog attack, according to the Georgia Bureau of Investigation.

news.title: Powder Springs man charged in Cobb County crash that killed child
news.summary: A Powder Springs man is being held without bond on a first-degree vehicular homicide charge in connection with a late-October crash in Marietta that killed a child passenger.

news.title: Katherine Johnston shooting: Vigil marks 20 years since fatal police raid
news.summary: Two decades after undercover Atlanta police officers fatally shot 92-year-old Katherine Johnston during a botched drug raid 20 years ago.

news.title: Woman arrested for allegedly taking MARTA Mobility bus, police say
news.summary: Atlanta Police and MARTA Police worked together to locate the vehicle and the suspect, who was identified as Sabrina Thomas.
